newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission to seek better gene-food labels.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission to seek better gene-food labels.

text.p: The European Commission will soon propose improved labelling of genetically-modified food products, EU Environment Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard said on Wednesday.
Bjerregaard was commenting after the Commission approved Swiss chemical company Ciba Geigy's application for market release of genetically modified maize in accordance with an EU directive.
"We must not miss this opportunity to repeat our clear signal that a better labelling is one of the ways forward in this area," Bjerregaard said in a statement.
"The Commission intends to deal further with this problem when a proposal - as soon as possible - will be put forward for revision of (the directive)," she added.
At present the directive does not allow obligatory labelling to show that a product is genetically modified without an assessment of the risk.
The Commission also recommended that the possibilities for labelling under a proposed EU regulation on genetically modified and other novel foods.
